business_problem: esure Group is a UK-based insurance firm on a mission to “fix insurance for good.” As part of this goal, it aims to provide customers with a better service, including personalized experiences, competitive prices, and fast resolutions to queries.
solution_summary: esure Group is a UK-based insurance firm on a mission to “fix insurance for good.” As part of this goal, it aims to provide customers with a better service, including personalized experiences, competitive prices, and fast resolutions to queries. esure built its cloud-native platform on AWS. The company can now easily and quickly integrate with third-party applications to expand its capabilities. To improve customer experience, for example, customers can interact with the business through apps offering self-service updates, chatbots, or human agents. It has added these services in months—something that would have taken up to 3 years to achieve on its on-premises infrastructure.

solution_components.role: Runs containerized services and scales application workloads across clusters.

solution_components.role: Stores documents, media, telemetry, or training data durably at scale.

solution_components.name: Amazon Connect Customer
solution_components.role: Serves customer interactions through contact-center and self-service experiences.

business_outcome: esure expects to complete the launch of its new platform and migrate its 2.3 million customers to AWS by the end of 2023. The company now plans to explore the Generative AI capabilities of Connect Customer as well as use other AWS services to further improve customer experience, insurance claim delivery, pricing, and fraud detection.
